_comment: Commands the Claude Code, grok and opencode Bash globs must refuse or leave alone, judged by an fnmatch stand-in for their matchers. Kept out of the suite: pr-guard reads the suite and refuses the merge commands. Text only: tests/test-harness.sh never runs a command.
refuse: geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
geectl remote create-token --operation trigger home:x pkg --live
allow: geectl local-build build --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 openssh-askpass-gnome --live
geectl local-build build --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 . --live
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project devel:x --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --live
geectl local-build chroot --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 .
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project devel:x --target-package pkg --description 'update config, pass tests' --changes-entry x --live
cd git-credential-oauth && geectl build list-binaries devel:tools:scm standard x86_64 --package git-credential-oauth
